Chapter 392: Chapter 10 The Silent Chikun Star Lord (Please Subscribe)_2

Finally, Gao Wufeng successfully passed the Heart Demon Tribulation.

As a result, his cultivation on the evolution path he had comprehended progressed smoothly, and he now stood at the forefront of all evolvers in terms of progress.

“The Mental Will Index hasn’t reached ten thousand, and yet he actively faced the Heart Demon Tribulation. His courage is commendable. Perhaps it’s precisely because of this that he is in harmony with the evolution path he’s cultivating, making everything else go smoothly afterward?”

Lin Yuan reflected privately.

He wouldn’t dare to do such a thing himself. Gao Wufeng was completely gambling with his own life. Now that he’s passed, he’s enjoying unlimited glory, but what if he hadn’t?

Who would still remember ‘Gao Wufeng’?

...

…

Personal space.

Gao Wufeng and Zuo Qiuguang were sitting there.

There were also a few other evolvers present.

Essentially, they were all geniuses who were still advancing on the path of the evolution paths they had comprehended.

“Peak Master Shisan has arrived.”

Upon seeing Lin Yuan, Gao Wufeng immediately greeted him.

“Peak Master Shisan.”

“Peak Master Shisan.”

The other evolvers did the same.

After all, Lin Yuan’s reputation as a genius was indeed formidable; no evolver dared to take him lightly.

Once Lin Yuan settled down, they resumed their conversation.

“Brother Gao, you must not be far from the Eighth Rank by now,” Zuo Qiuguang remarked, looking at Gao Wufeng with admiration. “To forcibly overcome the Heart Demon Tribulation, I admire your courage.”

Zuo Qiuguang was very clear that if she were in Gao Wufeng’s position, she would most likely not dare to continue cultivating.

“This time it was the Heart Demon Tribulation I faced, next time, who knows what it will be…”

Gao Wufeng said humbly.

In truth, Gao Wufeng was quite pleased with himself because he had bet correctly, and now his cultivation was going extremely smoothly.

At this moment, Gao Wufeng even had a wild ambition. He believed the evolution path he was cultivating was the Supreme Evolution Path left by the Supreme Being.

Otherwise, how could he possibly be cultivating so smoothly now?

“I must have passed the test. Only by overcoming the Heart Demon Tribulation and possessing an unstoppable mindset can one pass the test.”

Gao Wufeng was swept up by surging emotions.

“Right,” Gao Wufeng’s eyes shifted, looking at Lin Yuan, “Peak Master Shisan, how’s your cultivation coming along? Haven’t picked an evolution path to cultivate yet?”

It was no secret that Lin Yuan wasn’t cultivating a comprehended evolution path.

“Right, I’m timid, afraid of making a mistake,” Lin Yuan said.

“Timid?” Gao Wufeng frowned. As a human evolver, one should be unstoppable and break through all obstacles.

Just like how he faced the threat of the Heart Demon Tribulation, he faced it head-on.

Now hasn’t he passed it and even gained great benefits?

“Peak Master Shisan, I have to say this: Sometimes, being timid isn’t a virtue. With the Virtual World acting as a barrier, even if something really goes wrong, you’d have the chance to start over. Why hesitate? Sometimes, if you don’t seize the opportunity, it’ll be difficult to grasp it later,” Gao Wufeng couldn’t help but advise Lin Yuan.

“Actually, I am also tempering my Spirit Will,” Lin Yuan added.

“Tempering the Spirit Will?”

The other evolvers glanced at each other.

They all felt Lin Yuan was being somewhat foolish. The Spirit Will could be gradually improved through many methods.

Using the precious opportunity of comprehending a part of the Supreme Being’s body to temper the Spirit Will? This was akin to trading a gem for a bead.

“Alright.”

“Let’s not talk about this.”

Gao Wufeng decided not to continue advising Lin Yuan.

Strictly speaking, he and Lin Yuan were in a competitive relationship since the Supreme Evolution Path could only accommodate one person to become a Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan, a prodigy with even superior talent and aptitude, was giving up the opportunity to cultivate the evolution path and to become a Supreme Being because of his timidity. Gao Wufeng ought to be happy about that.

“I’ve called you all here this time because I want to discuss some questions encountered during cultivation,” Gao Wufeng stated, as it was common for evolvers to exchange experiences, especially since they were all cultivating evolution paths learned from the same source.

They chatted for half a day.

Lin Yuan was listening at the side.

“I wonder if Peak Master Shisan has any insights?”

Gao Wufeng still valued Lin Yuan’s opinion. Even if Lin Yuan had not cultivated it, as a top genius, his knowledge and thoughts would surely have something out of the ordinary.

“Brother Gao, I think the evolution path you are cultivating now will likely have an impact on your Spirit Will later on…” Lin Yuan paused for a moment before speaking.

“Influence my Spirit Will?”

Gao Wufeng pondered for a moment and replied, “Thanks for the reminder, Peak Master Shisan. I understand.”

What did it matter if it influenced his Spirit Will? As long as he could become a Supreme Being, paying any price was worth it.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness returned to reality.

“Gao Wufeng…must be in trouble now…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Based on the description by Gao Wufeng, Lin Yuan had also comprehended the evolution path in question and had analyzed it, finding that it was a huge pitfall later on.

Initially, Lin Yuan wanted to remind Gao Wufeng.

But seeing Gao Wufeng’s dismissive attitude, he decided not to continue.

Now, Gao Wufeng was immersed in his beautiful dream of becoming a Supreme Being, and nobody’s words would be effective.

Is becoming a Supreme Being really that easy?

Just then.

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

He looked up towards a certain direction.

There was a fluctuation of the space force.

“Opening up the inner world?”

“Did Big Brother have a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer?”

Lin Yuan stepped out of the great hall, speculating in his mind.

Two or three years ago, after Big Brother returned from the Battlefields of Different Races, he faced the killing intent of an Eighth Layer alien race and experienced the threat of life and death.

At that time, Big Brother had deep insights, and after returning, he began to close off for retreat, not even participating in the comprehension of a Supreme Being’s partial body this time.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan flew to the front of the first peak.

The other eleven disciples also arrived.

They waited outside for Big Brother to complete his breakthrough.

Hum…

The fluctuations of the space force.

From beginning to end, it was extremely stable.

“There shouldn’t be any problem.”

After observing for a while, Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although Lin Yuan had not yet made a breakthrough to the Eighth Layer, he had the experience of opening up an inner world and knew that Big Brother was having a very smooth time opening his inner world now.

The most difficult part for a Seventh Rank Evolver to break through to the Eighth Rank Evolver is to open up the inner world.

Like Lin Yuan, whose inner world had reached more than a hundred thousand miles in circumference, and yet still stuck at the Spirit Will hurdle, it was indeed extremely rare.

Mainly because Lin Yuan was too young and cultivated too quickly.

A moment later.

The spatial fluctuations stabilized.

Big Brother’s figure also swiftly flew out.

“Congratulations, Big Brother.”

“Congratulations, Big Brother, for breaking through to the Eighth Layer.”

…

All the Peak Masters congratulated him in unison, and Big Brother was also all smiles.

“Come over, all of you.”

Suddenly, the voice of Chikun Star Lord, the teacher, rang in the ears of Lin Yuan and the others.

“The teacher is calling us.”

“Let’s hurry over.”

“It must be to praise Big Brother’s breakthrough.”

“I’m so envious, when can I break through to the Eighth Layer…”

Lin Yuan and the other Peak Masters flew towards the central main peak.

…

The crimson great hall.

Chikun Star Lord was seated high above.

Big Brother and the other disciples stood on both sides.

“Well done.”

Chikun Star Lord looked at Big Brother and nodded slightly.

“Thank you, teacher.”

Big Brother was overjoyed.

Breaking through to the Eighth Layer, he was happy too, as this was the most critical stage for human Evolvers.

As an Eighth Rank Evolver, one could dominate a Star Domain, become a Star Lord, and deter all directions.

He could be called a grand official who sealed borders.

“How big is your inner world?” Chikun Star Lord asked after thinking for a moment.

When Evolvers open their inner world, as long as it is under a thousand miles in circumference, they can actively suppress it without triggering a world’s phantom.

“Teacher, my inner world is two hundred and twenty miles in circumference,” said Big Brother with an excited tone.

Generally, Evolvers who have newly advanced to the Eighth Layer have inner worlds of only a hundred miles in circumference.

For Big Brother to reach two hundred and twenty miles in circumference, it was clearly much stronger than the average newly advanced Eighth Rank Evolver.

“Just having reached the Eighth Layer, Big Brother already has an inner world of two hundred and twenty miles in circumference, his potential is limitless…”

“Big Brother, you must lead me in the future, give me some guidance.”

“With such a large inner world, how strong must the derived world force be?”

…

The Peak Masters discussed among themselves with tones of admiration, full of envy.

Especially the Second and Third disciples, they were also at the Seventh Rank,

Though they had not reached the peak of Kingship level, they could also look forward to the Eighth Layer,

And they were clear about how rare it was for Big Brother to open up an inner world of two hundred and twenty miles in circumference.

“An inner world of two hundred and twenty miles in circumference?”

Chikun Star Lord glanced at the spirited Great Peak Master

Then looked at Lin Yuan, quietly sitting there with a smile on his face.

He said nothing.
